Caruana forward selection picked rf+catboost as complementary pair; testing if a minimal focused pool beats the broader stable pool3

decision.justification: The series is trend-dominated with moderate seasonality, stationary, and exhibits unstable model ranking (Kendall tau 0.135) with high cross-model error correlation (mean 0.782, 9 redundant groups). With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights and per-horizon selection carry high estimation variance. A simple mean over the 9 most consistently-ranked models (pool3) is the most robust combination: it diversifies across independent error groups without overfitting to window-specific rankings. All 10 alternative strategies tested—median, trimmed_mean, smaller pools (k=2,5,7), forward selection, and inverse-error weighting—scored worse, confirming that breadth and simplicity outperform selectivity or adaptivity here.
